name: stca
description: Learn readable polymer structure-property rules, screen candidates, and generate and verify polymer repeat units with STCA.

interface.longDescription: Learn and save readable STCA and WRAcc rules from polymer structure-property data, with screening results for every requested tier. Screen candidates with paper, open-data or saved rules, or choose a rule to generate and verify polymer repeat units. Preserve original polymer SMILES and attachment points. The current AI assistant handles compatible CPU environment discovery, saves reusable rule files and continues in natural language.
defaultPrompt: Learn and save rules from my data.
Screen candidates with my selected rules.
Generate candidates with my saved rules.
